_comment: The tile race submissions seam. discord-server calls api-backend over HTTP with the METRICS_API_KEY as a verification-code header; api-backend owns every tile race table and the claim state machine. Asserted by api-backend/app/tests/test_tilerace_submissions.py and discord-server/tests/test_tilerace_submissions_contract.py.
_claim_comment: A tile is `claimed` once every requirement leaf carries a submission that has not been rejected - that is what unlocks the next roll, with no staff wait. Staff approval upgrades the completion row to `approved`; a rejection sets it to `rejected` and sends the team back to that tile, remembering `furthest_position` until the tile is claimed again.

tile.title: Bandos armour
tile.description: Any two pieces from General Graardor.

_outstanding_comment: `outstanding` is how many MORE leaves must be proved, not how many are unticked: an `or` costs its cheapest branch and a `not` costs nothing. The bot prints this count and renders `requirement_lines` verbatim - it never counts leaves itself, because a flat leaf list cannot tell 'all of these' from 'any one of these'.
_needed_comment: `needed` marks a leaf whose proof would bring the tile closer to satisfied, and is what the submission select offers. Every branch of an unproved `or` is needed; once one branch lands the others go false, as do all leaves under a `not`.

any_of_context_response._comment: Same seam, a tile asking for any one of three items with nothing proved yet. Three leaves are offered, but only one submission is outstanding.
